typescript.title: TypeScript REST API starter
typescript.description: An Express API with user registration, login, JWT authentication and post creation.
typescript.detail: The code separates controllers, services, models and middleware. Joi validates request bodies, Mongoose handles MongoDB access, and shared middleware handles errors. The repository has no automated test suite.

graphql.title: GraphQL post API
graphql.description: A small Apollo Server API for querying, creating, updating and deleting posts in MongoDB.
graphql.detail: GraphQL type definitions describe posts, queries and mutations. Resolvers use Mongoose models for persistence, with Apollo Server mounted on Express. It is an earlier CRUD example.

prisma.title: Prisma product API
prisma.description: A REST API for products and categories using Express, Prisma and SQLite.
prisma.detail: The schema defines a category-to-products relationship. Routes cover product CRUD and related category data, and the repository includes an initial database migration.

Bio.title: About me
Bio.intro: I'm Milad Akbari, a Full Stack AI Engineer based in Munich. I work across backend systems, web applications and AI-enabled workflows.
Bio.aampere: Since November 2024, I've worked as a Full Stack Developer at Aampere, developing its Dealer Platform for the European electric vehicle market. My work covers TypeScript and NestJS services, Next.js and React applications, and AI-assisted workflows.
Bio.maarif: Before Aampere, I developed learning management and financial administration software at the Turkish Maarif Foundation. I joined as a Working Student in June 2020 and worked as a Full Stack Developer from February 2021 to May 2023.
Bio.education: I hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science from Kardan University, where I studied from 2017 to 2021.
Bio.approach: I care about readable code, useful tests, clear data models, and applications that are straightforward to deploy and monitor.
